decision_needed.question: The Depreciation Fund schedule (p9) shows a 140,000 'Transfer in From General', counted inside the p4 'Other local receipts' of the General Fund column, but the General Fund schedule (pp6-8) and the p5 combining schedule show no matching 140,000 transfer out (General Fund transfers out are only 301,656 to Activities and Nutrition, and its balance ties without it). Where is the General Fund's 140,000 outflow (inside a spending line, or netted against a receipt line), and should a matching transfers_out / contra line be recorded?
decision_needed.recorded_as: 140,000 removed from Other local receipts (220,836 printed, 80,836 recorded, split_from/computed) and added to transfers_in (441,656); transfers_out only the printed 301,656; disbursements as printed (11,452,778); total receipts printed 12,864,817 kept in reported_totals with includes_split

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds incl. School Nutrition and Activity are columns of the governmental funds statement (p4), so no business-type section (business_type null). Receipts/disbursements from p4 Total Governmental Funds column. Beginning/ending are total fund balances (cash) from p4; ending = cash in bank 4,906,424 + county treasurer 1,230,329 (p3). Transfers: General (301,656) = Activity 176,656 + School Nutrition 125,000 (p4, net zero in total column). The General Fund column on p4 also contains the Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (p5 combining schedule); the 140,000 General-to-Depreciation transfer printed inside 'Other local receipts' is moved to transfers_in (Other local receipts recorded 80,836); no matching General Fund outflow is printed anywhere, so transfers_out stays 301,656 (decision_needed). Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental Activities column; Foundation component unit excluded; no liabilities reported. Detail: General Fund schedule (pp6-8) has no object breakdown so spending is 'not itemized'; General Fund budget schedule used rather than Exhibit-type object schedule (none in the PDF). Fund schedules pp9-17 recorded fund by fund; Depreciation and Employee Benefit are part of the General Fund column on p4. Budget amounts printed only at total level, so budget_final is null on lines. Special Building printed Total Receipts (448,635) is wrong, see report_discrepancies. Read pages 1-17 of 17.
